name: sniftr-ai-toolkit

scripts.validate:codex: npm run validate:versions && test -f .agents/plugins/marketplace.json && test -f providers/codex/plugin/.codex-plugin/plugin.json && test -f providers/codex/plugin/.mcp.json && test -d providers/codex/plugin/skills
scripts.validate:claude: npm run validate:versions && test -f .claude-plugin/marketplace.json && test -f providers/claude/plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json && test -f providers/claude/plugin/.mcp.json && test -d providers/claude/plugin/skills
scripts.validate:cursor: npm run validate:versions && test -f .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json && test -f providers/cursor/plugin/plugin.json && test -f providers/cursor/plugin/mcp.json && test -d providers/cursor/plugin/skills
scripts.validate:kiro: npm run validate:versions && test -f plugin.json && test -f mcp.json && test -d skills && test -d dev.kiro/steering
